name: Pinterest

Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Moderate - an async CodeSignal test for new grads vs. a live CoderPad session for experienced hires, then a 4-6 round onsite
rounds: Recruiter screen (30-45 min): background, motivation, and Pinterest’s "PinFlex" flexible-work-model preferences
Technical screen: an asynchronous CodeSignal test for new grads/interns (1-2 DS&A problems: arrays, strings, hash maps, trees, graphs); a live CoderPad session for experienced hires
Onsite coding round(s) (~45 min each): algorithms, clean code, communication
Onsite system design round (~60 min): architecture, scaling, product thinking
Onsite project-review and behavioral rounds (~45 min each): past work, collaboration, values fit
extraTopics: PinFlex (Pinterest’s flexible/remote work policy) comes up explicitly in the recruiter screen - have a clear answer ready
Tying system design answers to product thinking, not just pure architecture
Software Engineer.notes: Total timeline is reported as 3-5 weeks, with a decision typically within a few days of the final round.
